answer_1.quote: The Analyst ... generates rich, structured student profiles from historical interaction data ... The dynamic textual profiles produced by the Analyst are intended to provide human-understandable summaries ...

answer_4.quote: Two expert annotators performed a forced-choice comparison on 100 profile pairs (initial vs. refined) produced by CIKT-Qwen2.5-7B on the ASSIST2009 dataset, deciding in each case which profile was better.
answer_4.guideline: Forced-choice comparison where annotators selected the better profile between the initial and refined versions.
